profile.source_vintage: Current linked-data snapshot, with a separately dated HPI release

candidates.name: Place, road and residual quarter effects

evaluation.design: Train 2010–2023 excluding 15% of properties. Select on Jan–Jun 2024. Calibrate on Jul–Dec 2024. Test on 2025. Refit through 2025 for website.
evaluation.caveat: Retrospective revised-data assessment. Type/area HPI for the target month is an observed market input. This does not test a real-time forecast before that index was published.

address_model.design: Base fit ends in 2023. Select prior-sale weights on Jan–Jun 2024. Calibrate on Jul–Dec 2024. Evaluate on 2025 using only an earlier same-address sale at least one year old.
address_model.caveat: Retrospective revised-snapshot assessment. Previous sale, unchanged address/type/tenure and dated HPI are required. Physical changes remain unmeasured. This is not a forecast or a bedroom adjustment.

geography_note: Core markets and surrounding postal areas are separate. Linslade uses explicit locality labels plus 201 postcodes whose current centroids fall in Leighton-Linslade West ward (E05014416). This is a stated ward proxy, not an exact house boundary. Unresolved and other Leighton Buzzard postcodes remain broader comparison context.

area_evaluation.design: Train through 2023 excluding 15% of properties. Select early 2024. Calibrate late 2024. Test 2025. Production refit through 2025.
area_evaluation.caveat: Retrospective revised-snapshot conditional valuation with observed HPI. Certificates must be lodged by each sale date. EPC area is not an estate-agent floor-plan measurement. Bedrooms are not modelled.

epc_note: Official domestic EPC extract through October 2026, retrieved 11 November 2026. Raw EPC addresses and contact fields are excluded. Internal floor area and energy rating retain certificate dates. Habitable rooms are not bedrooms.
